summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated Bun bundle
details: @onereach/or-browser@0.0.48 declares a `preinstall` hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<PM>.zip`, extracts and chmods the binary in a temp directory, and then invokes it via `execFileSync(bun, ['math_init.js'], {cwd: D})`. The sibling `math_init.js` is a single-line ~727 KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a shuffled string-array lookup (`WV8StW` rotating `n7gIxM`, custom-alphabet decoder `hc1jfK9`) and mangled identifiers, so its runtime behavior is not readable without execution. The package advertises itself as a Vue asset-browser UI component, a purpose that does not require pulling down an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time specifically to execute an opaque bundle under it. The delivery shape — install-time fetch of an alien runtime used to execute an obfuscated in-package payload — grants code execution on the installer host on every `npm install`, and the choice of a non-Node runtime evades Node-based static and dynamic scans of the executed code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
